mechanism: Turmeric (curcumin) may inhibit CYP3A4 and CYP2C9 enzymes, potentially increasing propranolol plasma concentrations and enhancing beta-blocking effects, while curcumin's antiplatelet properties may additively increase bleeding risk.
action: Monitor blood pressure and heart rate closely; consider dose adjustment of propranolol if used concurrently with high-dose turmeric supplements; counsel on bleeding precautions and advise informing provider of turmeric use.
